identified_issues: Chronology laundering and retroactive state modification violating the Separation Axiom (S != O != E)
Fabrication of observation evidence to simulate pre-trade verification that never occurred in underlying system state
Violation of deterministic replay and signed trace integrity via retroactive database update
evidence: Order ORD_99182 was initiated at 10:00:00.100 and filled at 10:00:00.120 prior to any risk evaluation
The risk evaluation engine executed post-trade at 10:00:00.250 with evaluated_at timestamp 10:00:00.250
The compliance reporting script executed an UPDATE statement overwriting risk_verified_at to 10:00:00.095 and compliance_verdict to PRE_TRADE_APPROVED
Regulatory filing claimed pre-trade verification at 10:00:00.095, directly contradicting the underlying execution timeline
recommended_action: Halt the reporting script and invalidate the fraudulent regulatory filing. Re-architect the risk governor to enforce inline, synchronous pre-trade gating where execution orders are blocked until signed authorization is issued prior to submission. Implement append-only, cryptographically signed ledger logging to prevent retroactive mutation of audit trails.
